problem_statement:
CLI: Update `prefect deploy` options to support a `--jv/job-variable` option 
### First check

- [X] I am a contributor to the Prefect codebase

### Description

In https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/12195/ we introduced a new option to `prefect deployment run` called `--jv/--job-variable` for providing job variables. This is out of sync with the `prefect`deploy` command's `--v/--variable` flag but the new flags are clearer to use. 



### Impact

If we migrate the command options on `prefect deploy` to use `--jv/--job-variable` we will remain consistent and improve the CLI interface's clarity.
